translations.web: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
translations.bsb: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
translations.kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
translations.asv: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
